passages.text: The sons of Issachar: Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimron—four in all.
passages.sermon:
Issachar was a son of Jacob.
Issachar had four sons.
Their names were Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimron.
There were four sons in total.
passages.original: וְלִבְנֵ֣י יִשָׂשכָ֗ר תּוֹלָ֧ע וּפוּאָ֛ה יָשִׁיב וְשִׁמְר֖וֹן אַרְבָּעָֽה׃ס

passages.text: The sons of Tola: Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, and Shemuel, the heads of their families. In the days of David, 22,600 descendants of Tola were numbered in their genealogies as mighty men of valor.
passages.sermon:
Tola was a son of Issachar.
Tola had six sons.
Their names were Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, and Shemuel.
These six sons became heads of their families.
They were leaders of their father's houses.
They were known as mighty men of valor.
In the days of King David, people counted their descendants.
The number of Tola’s descendants was 22,600.
These were all listed in their genealogies.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֣י תוֹלָ֗ע עֻזִּ֡י וּרְפָיָ֡ה וִֽ֠ירִיאֵל וְיַחְמַ֨י וְיִבְשָׂ֜ם וּשְׁמוּאֵ֗ל רָאשִׁ֤ים לְבֵית־ אֲבוֹתָם֙ לְתוֹלָ֔ע גִּבּ֥וֹרֵי חַ֖יִל לְתֹלְדוֹתָ֑ם מִסְפָּרָם֙ בִּימֵ֣י דָוִ֔יד עֶשְׂרִֽים־ וּשְׁנַ֥יִם אֶ֖לֶף וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃ס

passages.text: The son of Uzzi: Izrahiah. The sons of Izrahiah: Michael, Obadiah, Joel, and Isshiah. All five of them were chiefs.
passages.sermon:
Uzzi had a son named Izrahiah.
Izrahiah had four sons.
Their names were Michael, Obadiah, Joel, and Isshiah.
Izrahiah and his four sons were five chiefs in total.
All five were leaders.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֥י עֻזִּ֖י יִֽזְרַֽחְיָ֑ה וּבְנֵ֣י יִֽזְרַֽחְיָ֗ה מִֽיכָאֵ֡ל וְ֠עֹבַדְיָה וְיוֹאֵ֧ל יִשִּׁיָּ֛ה חֲמִשָּׁ֖ה רָאשִׁ֥ים כֻּלָּֽם׃

passages.text: In addition to them, according to their genealogy, they had 36,000 troops for battle, for they had many wives and children.
passages.sermon:
The descendants of Tola belonged to the tribe of Issachar.
They kept records of their families.
They had 36,000 men ready for battle.
These men came from their many wives and children.
passages.original: וַעֲלֵיהֶ֨ם לְתֹלְדוֹתָ֜ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבוֹתָ֗ם גְּדוּדֵי֙ צְבָ֣א מִלְחָמָ֔ה שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וְשִׁשָּׁ֖ה אָ֑לֶף כִּֽי־ הִרְבּ֥וּ נָשִׁ֖ים וּבָנִֽים׃

passages.text: Their kinsmen belonging to all the families of Issachar who were mighty men of valor totaled 87,000, as listed in their genealogies.
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Issachar had many families.
Their kinsmen belonged to all these families.
These kinsmen were mighty men of valor.
There were 87,000 of them.
The genealogies listed all of them.
passages.original: וַאֲחֵיהֶ֗ם לְכֹל֙ מִשְׁפְּח֣וֹת יִשָׂשכָ֔ר גִּבּוֹרֵ֖י חֲיָלִ֑ים שְׁמוֹנִ֤ים וְשִׁבְעָה֙ אֶ֔לֶף הִתְיַחְשָׂ֖ם לַכֹּֽל׃פ

passages.text: The three sons of Benjamin: Bela, Becher, and Jediael.
passages.sermon: Benjamin had three sons.\r\nTheir names were Bela, Becher, and Jediael.
passages.original: בִּנְיָמִ֗ן בֶּ֧לַע וָבֶ֛כֶר וִידִֽיעֲאֵ֖ל שְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃

passages.text: The sons of Bela: Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, and Iri, heads of their families—five in all. There were 22,034 mighty men of valor listed in their genealogies.
passages.sermon:
Bela was a son of Benjamin.
Bela had five sons.
Their names were Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, and Iri.
Each son became the head of his family.
These five men were leaders.
They were mighty men of valor.
Their genealogies listed 22,034 men.
All these men were counted as mighty men of valor.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֣י בֶ֗לַע אֶצְבּ֡וֹן וְעֻזִּ֡י וְ֠עֻזִּיאֵל וִירִימ֨וֹת וְעִירִ֜י חֲמִשָּׁ֗ה רָאשֵׁי֙ בֵּ֣ית אָב֔וֹת גִּבּוֹרֵ֖י חֲיָלִ֑ים וְהִתְיַחְשָׂ֗ם עֶשְׂרִ֤ים וּשְׁנַ֙יִם֙ אֶ֔לֶף וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֖ים וְאַרְבָּעָֽה׃ס

passages.text: The sons of Becher: Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth; all these were Becher’s sons.
passages.sermon:
Becher was a son of Benjamin.
Becher had sons.
Their names were Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth.
All these men were sons of Becher.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֣י בֶ֗כֶר זְמִירָ֡ה וְיוֹעָ֡שׁ וֶ֠אֱלִיעֶזֶר וְאֶלְיוֹעֵינַ֤י וְעָמְרִי֙ וִירֵמ֣וֹת וַאֲבִיָּ֔ה וַעֲנָת֖וֹת וְעָלָ֑מֶת כָּל־ אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵי־ בָֽכֶר׃

passages.text: Their genealogies were recorded according to the heads of their families—20,200 mighty men of valor.
passages.sermon:
The people kept records of their families.
They listed each family by its leader.
These leaders were heads of their fathers’ houses.
They were mighty men of valor.
There were 20,200 of these men.
passages.original: וְהִתְיַחְשָׂ֣ם לְתֹלְדוֹתָ֗ם רָאשֵׁי֙ בֵּ֣ית אֲבוֹתָ֔ם גִּבּוֹרֵ֖י חָ֑יִל עֶשְׂרִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף וּמָאתָֽיִם׃ס

passages.text: The son of Jediael: Bilhan. The sons of Bilhan: Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar.
passages.sermon: Jediael had a son named Bilhan.\r\nBilhan had seven sons.\r\nTheir names were Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֥י יְדִיעֲאֵ֖ל בִּלְהָ֑ן וּבְנֵ֣י בִלְהָ֗ן יְעִישׁ וּ֠בִנְיָמִן וְאֵה֤וּד וּֽכְנַעֲנָה֙ וְזֵיתָ֔ן וְתַרְשִׁ֖ישׁ וַאֲחִישָֽׁחַר׃

passages.text: All these sons of Jediael were heads of their families, mighty men of valor; there were 17,200 fit for battle.
passages.sermon:
Jediael had sons.
These sons led their families.
They were mighty men of valor.
There were 17,200 of them.
They were fit for battle.
passages.original: כָּל־ אֵ֜לֶּה בְּנֵ֤י יְדִֽיעֲאֵל֙ לְרָאשֵׁ֣י הָאָב֔וֹת גִּבּוֹרֵ֖י חֲיָלִ֑ים שִׁבְעָֽה־ עָשָׂ֥ר אֶ֙לֶף֙ וּמָאתַ֔יִם יֹצְאֵ֥י צָבָ֖א לַמִּלְחָמָֽה׃

passages.text: The Shuppites and Huppites were descendants of Ir, and the Hushites were descendants of Aher.
passages.sermon: The Shuppites are descendants of Ir.\r\nThe Huppites are descendants of Ir.\r\nThe Hushites are descendants of Aher.
passages.original: וְשֻׁפִּ֤ם וְחֻפִּם֙ בְּנֵ֣י עִ֔יר חֻשִׁ֖ם בְּנֵ֥י אַחֵֽר׃

passages.text: The sons of Naphtali: Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, and Shallum —the descendants of Bilhah.
passages.sermon:
Naphtali was a son of Jacob.
Bilhah was Naphtali’s mother.
Naphtali had four sons.
Their names were Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, and Shallum.
These four men were descendants of Bilhah.
passages.original: בְּנֵ֣י נַפְתָּלִ֗י יַחֲצִיאֵ֧ל וְגוּנִ֛י וְיֵ֥צֶר וְשַׁלּ֖וּם בְּנֵ֥י בִלְהָֽה׃פ

passages.text: The descendants of Manasseh: Through his Aramean concubine, Asriel, as well as Machir the father of Gilead.
passages.sermon:
Manasseh had descendants.
Manasseh had an Aramean concubine.
The Aramean concubine gave birth to Asriel.
The Aramean concubine also gave birth to Machir.
Machir was the father of Gilead.
passages.original: בְּנֵ֣י מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה אַשְׂרִיאֵ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָלָ֑דָה פִּֽילַגְשׁוֹ֙ הָֽאֲרַמִּיָּ֔ה יָלְדָ֕ה אֶת־ מָכִ֖יר אֲבִ֥י גִלְעָֽד׃

passages.text: Machir took a wife from among the Huppites and Shuppites. The name of his sister was Maacah. Another descendant was named Zelophehad, who had only daughters.
passages.sermon:
Machir was a descendant of Manasseh.
Machir took a wife from the Huppites and Shuppites.
Machir had a sister named Maacah.
Another descendant was named Zelophehad.
Zelophehad had only daughters.
passages.original: וּמָכִ֞יר לָקַ֤ח אִשָּׁה֙ לְחֻפִּ֣ים וּלְשֻׁפִּ֔ים וְשֵׁ֤ם אֲחֹתוֹ֙ מַעֲכָ֔ה וְשֵׁ֥ם הַשֵּׁנִ֖י צְלָפְחָ֑ד וַתִּהְיֶ֥נָה לִצְלָפְחָ֖ד בָּנֽוֹת׃

passages.text: Machir’s wife Maacah gave birth to a son, and she named him Peresh. His brother was named Sheresh, and his sons were Ulam and Rekem.
passages.sermon:
Maacah was the wife of Machir.
Maacah gave birth to a son.
She named her son Peresh.
Peresh had a brother named Sheresh.
Sheresh had two sons.
Their names were Ulam and Rekem.
passages.original: וַתֵּ֨לֶד מַעֲכָ֤ה אֵֽשֶׁת־ מָכִיר֙ בֵּ֔ן וַתִּקְרָ֤א שְׁמוֹ֙ פֶּ֔רֶשׁ וְשֵׁ֥ם אָחִ֖יו שָׁ֑רֶשׁ וּבָנָ֖יו אוּלָ֥ם וָרָֽקֶם׃

passages.text: The son of Ulam: Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.
passages.sermon:
Ulam had a son named Bedan.
Gilead was the son of Machir.
Machir was the son of Manasseh.
Bedan and others were sons of Gilead.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֥י אוּלָ֖ם בְּדָ֑ן אֵ֚לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י גִלְעָ֔ד בֶּן־ מָכִ֖יר בֶּן־ מְנַשֶּֽׁה׃

passages.text: His sister Hammolecheth gave birth to Ishhod, Abiezer, and Mahlah.
passages.sermon:
Hammolecheth was the sister of Gilead, son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.
Hammolecheth gave birth to Ishhod.
Hammolecheth gave birth to Abiezer.
Hammolecheth gave birth to Mahlah.
passages.original: וַאֲחֹת֖וֹ הַמֹּלֶ֑כֶת יָלְדָה֙ אֶת־ אִישְׁה֔וֹד וְאֶת־ אֲבִיעֶ֖זֶר וְאֶת־ מַחְלָֽה׃

passages.text: And these were the sons of Shemida: Ahian, Shechem, Likhi, and Aniam.
passages.sermon: Shemida was a man.\r\nShemida had sons.\r\nHis sons were Ahian, Shechem, Likhi, and Aniam.
passages.original: וַיִּהְי֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י שְׁמִידָ֑ע אַחְיָ֣ן וָשֶׁ֔כֶם וְלִקְחִ֖י וַאֲנִיעָֽם׃פ

passages.text: The descendants of Ephraim: Shuthelah, Bered his son, Tahath his son, Eleadah his son, Tahath his son, Zabad his son, and Shuthelah his son. Ezer and Elead were killed by the natives of Gath, because they went down to steal their livestock.
passages.sermon:
Ephraim was the father of several descendants.
His son was Shuthelah.
Shuthelah’s son was Bered.
Bered’s son was Tahath.
Tahath’s son was Eleadah.
Eleadah’s son was Tahath.
Tahath’s son was Zabad.
Zabad’s son was Shuthelah.
Ephraim also had descendants named Ezer and Elead.
Men from Gath were natives of the land.
These men killed Ezer and Elead.
Ezer and Elead went down to take livestock from the men of Gath.
The men of Gath killed them because of this.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֥י אֶפְרַ֖יִם שׁוּתָ֑לַח וּבֶ֤רֶד בְּנוֹ֙ וְתַ֣חַת בְּנ֔וֹ וְאֶלְעָדָ֥ה בְנ֖וֹ וְתַ֥חַת בְּנֽוֹ׃ וְזָבָ֥ד בְּנ֛וֹ וְשׁוּתֶ֥לַח בְּנ֖וֹ וְעֵ֣זֶר וְאֶלְעָ֑ד וַהֲרָג֗וּם אַנְשֵׁי־ גַת֙ הַנּוֹלָדִ֣ים בָּאָ֔רֶץ כִּ֣י יָרְד֔וּ לָקַ֖חַת אֶת־ מִקְנֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: Their father Ephraim mourned for many days, and his relatives came to comfort him.
passages.sermon: Ephraim was the father of Ezer and Elead.\r\nEphraim mourned for many days.\r\nHis relatives came to comfort him.
passages.original: וַיִּתְאַבֵּ֛ל אֶפְרַ֥יִם אֲבִיהֶ֖ם יָמִ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים וַיָּבֹ֥אוּ אֶחָ֖יו לְנַחֲמֽוֹ׃

passages.text: And again he slept with his wife, and she conceived and gave birth to a son. So he named him Beriah, because tragedy had come upon his house.
passages.sermon:
Ephraim was the father.
Ephraim had lost his sons Ezer and Elead.
Ephraim slept with his wife again.
His wife became pregnant.
She gave birth to a son.
Ephraim named the son Beriah.
Ephraim chose this name because tragedy had come upon his house.
passages.original: וַיָּבֹא֙ אֶל־ אִשְׁתּ֔וֹ וַתַּ֖הַר וַתֵּ֣לֶד בֵּ֑ן וַיִּקְרָ֤א אֶת־ שְׁמוֹ֙ בְּרִיעָ֔ה כִּ֥י בְרָעָ֖ה הָיְתָ֥ה בְּבֵיתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: His daughter was Sheerah, who built Lower and Upper Beth-horon, as well as Uzzen-sheerah.
passages.sermon:
Ephraim had a daughter named Sheerah.
Sheerah built Lower Beth-horon.
Sheerah built Upper Beth-horon.
Sheerah also built Uzzen-sheerah.
passages.original: וּבִתּ֣וֹ שֶׁאֱרָ֔ה וַתִּ֧בֶן אֶת־ בֵּית־ חוֹר֛וֹן הַתַּחְתּ֖וֹן וְאֶת־ הָעֶלְי֑וֹן וְאֵ֖ת אֻזֵּ֥ן שֶׁאֱרָֽה׃

passages.text: Additionally, Rephah was his son, Resheph his son, Telah his son, Tahan his son, Ladan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son, Nun his son, and Joshua his son.
passages.sermon:
These are the descendants of Ephraim, son of Joseph, son of Israel.
Rephah was the son of Ephraim.
Resheph was the son of Rephah.
Telah was the son of Resheph.
Tahan was the son of Telah.
Ladan was the son of Tahan.
Ammihud was the son of Ladan.
Elishama was the son of Ammihud.
Nun was the son of Elishama.
Joshua was the son of Nun.
passages.original: וְרֶ֣פַח בְּנ֗וֹ וְרֶ֧שֶׁף וְתֶ֛לַח בְּנ֖וֹ וְתַ֥חַן בְּנֽוֹ׃ לַעְדָּ֥ן בְּנ֛וֹ עַמִּיה֥וּד בְּנ֖וֹ אֱלִישָׁמָ֥ע בְּנֽוֹ׃ נ֥וֹן בְּנ֖וֹ יְהוֹשֻׁ֥עַ בְּנֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Their holdings and settlements included Bethel and its villages, Naaran to the east, Gezer and its villages to the west, and Shechem and its villages as far as Ayyah and its villages.
passages.sermon:
The descendants of Joseph son of Israel owned land and lived in certain places.
They had holdings and settlements.
They lived in Bethel.
They also lived in the villages around Bethel.
To the east, they lived in Naaran.
To the west, they lived in Gezer.
They also lived in the villages around Gezer.
They lived in Shechem.
They also lived in the villages around Shechem.
They lived as far as Ayyah.
They also lived in the villages around Ayyah.
passages.original: וַאֲחֻזָּתָם֙ וּמֹ֣שְׁבוֹתָ֔ם בֵּֽית־ אֵ֖ל וּבְנֹתֶ֑יהָ וְלַמִּזְרָ֣ח נַעֲרָ֔ן וְלַֽמַּעֲרָ֗ב גֶּ֤זֶר וּבְנֹתֶ֙יהָ֙ וּשְׁכֶ֣ם וּבְנֹתֶ֔יהָ עַד־ עַיָּ֖ה וּבְנֹתֶֽיהָ׃

passages.text: And along the borders of Manasseh were Beth-shean, Taanach, Megiddo, and Dor, together with their villages. The descendants of Joseph son of Israel lived in these towns.
passages.sermon:
The descendants of Joseph were the sons of Israel.
They lived in certain towns.
These towns were along the borders of Manasseh.
The towns included Beth-shean and its villages.
They also included Taanach and its villages.
They included Megiddo and its villages.
They included Dor and its villages.
passages.original: וְעַל־ יְדֵ֣י בְנֵי־ מְנַשֶּׁ֗ה בֵּית־ שְׁאָ֤ן וּבְנֹתֶ֙יהָ֙ תַּעְנַ֣ךְ וּבְנֹתֶ֔יהָ מְגִדּ֥וֹ וּבְנוֹתֶ֖יהָ דּ֣וֹר וּבְנוֹתֶ֑יהָ בְּאֵ֙לֶּה֙ יָשְׁב֔וּ בְּנֵ֥י יוֹסֵ֖ף בֶּן־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ

passages.text: The children of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, Beriah, and their sister Serah.
passages.sermon:
Asher was a son of Israel.
Asher had children.
His sons were Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, and Beriah.
He had a daughter named Serah.
Serah was their sister.
passages.original: בְּנֵ֣י אָשֵׁ֗ר יִמְנָ֧ה וְיִשְׁוָ֛ה וְיִשְׁוִ֥י וּבְרִיעָ֖ה וְשֶׂ֥רַח אֲחוֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: The sons of Beriah: Heber, as well as Malchiel, who was the father of Birzaith.
passages.sermon: Beriah had two sons.\r\nTheir names were Heber and Malchiel.\r\nMalchiel was the father of Birzaith.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֣י בְרִיעָ֔ה חֶ֖בֶר וּמַלְכִּיאֵ֑ל ה֖וּא אֲבִ֥י בִרְזוֹת׃

passages.text: Heber was the father of Japhlet, Shomer, and Hotham, and of their sister Shua.
passages.sermon:
Heber was a descendant of Asher.
Heber had three sons.
Their names were Japhlet, Shomer, and Hotham.
Heber also had a daughter.
Her name was Shua.
Shua was the sister of Japhlet, Shomer, and Hotham.
passages.original: וְחֶ֙בֶר֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־ יַפְלֵ֔ט וְאֶת־ שׁוֹמֵ֖ר וְאֶת־ חוֹתָ֑ם וְאֵ֖ת שׁוּעָ֥א אֲחוֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: The sons of Japhlet: Pasach, Bimhal, and Ashvath. These were Japhlet’s sons.
passages.sermon:
Japhlet was a man.
Japhlet had sons.
His sons were Pasach, Bimhal, and Ashvath.
These three were the sons of Japhlet.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֣י יַפְלֵ֔ט פָּסַ֥ךְ וּבִמְהָ֖ל וְעַשְׁוָ֑ת אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י יַפְלֵֽט׃

passages.text: The sons of Shemer: Ahi, Rohgah, Hubbah, and Aram.
passages.sermon: Shemer was a man.\r\nShemer had sons.\r\nHis sons were Ahi, Rohgah, Hubbah, and Aram.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֖י שָׁ֑מֶר אֲחִ֥י וְרוֹהֲגָה יַחְבָּה וַאֲרָֽם׃

passages.text: The sons of his brother Helem: Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, and Amal.
passages.sermon: Helem had a brother.\r\nHelem’s brother had sons.\r\nThe sons were Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, and Amal.
passages.original: וּבֶן־ הֵ֖לֶם אָחִ֑יו צוֹפַ֥ח וְיִמְנָ֖ע וְשֵׁ֥לֶשׁ וְעָמָֽל׃

passages.text: The sons of Zophah: Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, Imrah, Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, and Beera.
passages.sermon:
Zophah was a descendant of Asher.
Zophah had sons.
His sons were Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, and Imrah.
His other sons were Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, and Beera.
passages.original: בְּנֵ֖י צוֹפָ֑ח ס֧וּחַ וְחַרְנֶ֛פֶר וְשׁוּעָ֖ל וּבֵרִ֥י וְיִמְרָֽה׃ בֶּ֣צֶר וָה֗וֹד וְשַׁמָּ֧א וְשִׁלְשָׁ֛ה וְיִתְרָ֖ן וּבְאֵרָֽא׃

passages.text: The sons of Jether: Jephunneh, Pispa, and Ara.
passages.sermon: Jether had sons.\r\nJether’s sons were Jephunneh, Pispa, and Ara.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֖י יֶ֑תֶר יְפֻנֶּ֥ה וּפִסְפָּ֖ה וַאְרָֽא׃

passages.text: The sons of Ulla: Arah, Hanniel, and Rizia.
passages.sermon:
Ulla was a man from the tribe of Asher.
Ulla had three sons.
The first son was Arah.
The second son was Hanniel.
The third son was Rizia.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֖י עֻלָּ֑א אָרַ֥ח וְחַנִּיאֵ֖ל וְרִצְיָֽא׃

passages.text: All these were the descendants of Asher—heads of their families, choice and mighty men of valor, and chiefs among the leaders. The number of men fit for battle, recorded in their genealogies, was 26,000.
passages.sermon:
These men were descendants of Asher.
They were heads of their families.
They were chosen men.
They were mighty men of valor.
They were chiefs among the leaders.
Their genealogies recorded them for military service.
The number of men fit for battle was 26,000.
passages.original: כָּל־ אֵ֣לֶּה בְנֵי־ אָ֠שֵׁר רָאשֵׁ֨י בֵית־ הָאָב֤וֹת בְּרוּרִים֙ גִּבּוֹרֵ֣י חֲיָלִ֔ים רָאשֵׁ֖י הַנְּשִׂיאִ֑ים וְהִתְיַחְשָׂ֤ם בַּצָּבָא֙ בַּמִּלְחָמָ֔ה מִסְפָּרָ֣ם אֲנָשִׁ֔ים עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְשִׁשָּׁ֖ה אָֽלֶף׃ס
